note: implementation hashes frozen before any N2 / X2 run (PVP-1A-DX)
decisions: world: one unmodified V2JoltWorld on the combined spec (runner 0–13, tackler 14–27), G1_WORLD settings (240 Hz, coll 1, 150 / 2, discrete) + actuators, gravity −9.81, the spec contact configuration (equal for both specs, checked)

per character: unmodified PassiveLayer {enabled, couplings, kneeModel v2k}, ActuatorLayer {}, solveStance(STANCE), StandController(SLP_STAND) as model, PostureDriver; through worldView (index offsets; any unmapped world function throws)
SnapshotTone exactly as IFM1Sim.toneCmd; a0 = coordsOf(qcs) of the written entry poses; ȧ0 = 0 (the entry has zero relative joint rates; asserted); ActuatorLayer init path at entry
tick order = G2Sim.tick: both P.apply + act.apply → one w.step(h, 1) → read → dampingLoss + act.after → P.compute + toneCmd + act.compute → record
contacts: post-step cache decode (track_a_lib) with pre-step COM transforms (IFM1 manifoldImpulses); kinds turf-runner / turf-tackler / self-* / cross

ledgers: per character Δ P / ΔL_O vs gravity + turf + cross impulses (+ position-correction term), system vs gravity + turf; energy E = KE + PE + passive U; per character residual includes the cross-contact work (IFM-1 F·v_mid·dt form); system Σ⁺ of ΔE − (W_act − D)
integrity per character = G1 _measure definitions (anchors, hard excess, engine stop margin < 0.25°, exact turf penetration) + self / cross penetration from manifold depths + ActuatorLayer overCap

C0 / X2 rejection through the listener validate callback (userData ranges); X2 = N2 to the end of the first step with a cross manifold |J2| ≥ 1e-3 N·s, snapshot (Jolt All + plant state), no-op proof, restore, reject

first physical contact attributed to the deepest qualifying cross manifold of the first contact step (REV2 A2); OC-3 at the first step n* with t ≥ t_phys + 0.060 s (n_phys + 15); remaining support = the physical left ankle joint centre
isolation: SOLO_R / SOLO_T = the same plant code with one character (world from that spec alone), compared with C0 over steps 1–36
safe stop: non-finite or any body > 25 m/s (stops the run; marker recorded)
disclosures: an 8-step C0 smoke test (cross pairs rejected; no contact possible) was run before this freeze to check the harness; it showed (a) zero turf impulse on both runner boots in step 1 (the frozen +0.5 mm grounding gap) — which conflicts with the frozen C0 runner criterion "impulse > 0 in every step" (my preregistration error; the criterion is kept and reported as written, with the IFM-1-style count labelled post-hoc); (b) the fitted tackler is supported by its pointed left boot, right foot and right forearm (pelvis above the turf), the right forearm strikes the turf at step 3 (13.4 N·s) and the tucked right foot spins up to 15–21 rad/s from sliding friction; the tackler angular ledger reached 0.067 N·m·s at step 3. No N2 / X2 step has been run.
